statement: A program sets i to 0, and while i < n adds 1 to i, for a whole number n of at least 0. SV-COMP's task loop-new/count_by_1 asserts afterwards that i equals n, its bound LARGE_INT. Define a function of an assertion, a predicate on a state {"i", "n"}, that gives true when every run that leaves the loop meets it, for every n, and false otherwise. The program's value is the function.
origin: SV-COMP's benchmark set (sv-benchmarks), ReachSafety, property unreach-call: c/loop-new/count_by_1.c (expected verdict true), with LARGE_INT, which the file leaves undefined, as any n of at least 0
